m.x: Sets the Euler angles from a Quaternion, using the specified rotation order.The quaternion is first converted to a rotation matrix internally, then`setFromRotationMatrix` is called to derive the Euler angles. This avoidsgimbal lock issues by working through the matrix representation.

p.x: The quaternion to derive Euler angles from.
The rotation order to use. Defaults to the current order if not specified.
Whether to invoke `onChangeCallback` after setting the values.

m.x: Sets the Euler angles from the upper-left 3x3 rotation portion of a 4x4 Matrix4,using the specified rotation order.The matrix is assumed to be a pure rotation matrix (un-scaled). Each supportedrotation order has its own decomposition formula. If the `update` parameter is`true`, `onChangeCallback` is invoked after the values are set.

p.x: The rotation matrix to derive Euler angles from. Must be a pure (un-scaled) rotation matrix.
